How we teach every language on this page

Live, with a mentor

Every class is a live online session, never a recording. Choose 1-on-1, a mini batch of 3 to 4, or a group of 5 to 10. Questions get answered in the moment they come up.

Learned by building

Each course is a sequence of projects that run: a game, a site, a model, an app. The language is the tool; the project is the lesson. Nothing on this page is taught as theory alone.

Certified on a real exam

A certificate from Modern Age Coders on passing the final exam, plus a portfolio of finished work that a school, college or employer can actually look at.

Group classes ₹1,499 a month, mini batch ₹2,999, 1-on-1 ₹4,999. Same price for every course on this page.
